subject.title: Migrate active GPT-5.5 defaults to GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna

question: Should OpenClaw complete the proposed Sol-for-product and Luna-for-validation split across all remaining active GPT-5.5 defaults, examples, specialized workloads, and automation?
rationale: Current source and upstream metadata establish that both models are supported, but assigning each workload sets a durable quality, cost, and release-validation policy that requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Complete classified migration
options.body: Move active product and high-capability paths to Sol, lower-cost validation paths to Luna, and preserve explicitly classified GPT-5.5 compatibility cases.

options.title: Migrate product surfaces only
options.body: Update active defaults, docs, examples, and specialized user workloads now while deferring QA and release automation changes.

options.title: Hold current partial state
options.body: Leave remaining GPT-5.5 references unchanged until additional comparative model evaluation is available.

recommendation.title: Complete classified migration
recommendation.body: Move active product and high-capability paths to Sol, lower-cost validation paths to Luna, and preserve explicitly classified GPT-5.5 compatibility cases.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current GPT-5.6 defaults and proposed the exact permanent workload split under review.
